All measurability and weighted-finiteness hypotheses match. Positive and negative parts establish slice integrability almost everywhere, integrability of slice integrals and the stated identity. The w = ∞ case is correctly handled by forcing q = 0 almost everywhere there.

The compact exhaustion is contained in U and cofinal among its compact subsets, including empty and whole-space cases. Countable intersection followed by monotonicity proves exactly the stated quantifier exchange without additional measurability assumptions.

The bounded bilinear construction has the intended continuous-linear-map types and operator norms. Continuous composition proves strong measurability; normalization, the explicit zero case and the wedge bound establish all three pointwise conclusions. The proof is complete and independent.
